notes.title: Update 1.1.1: Sharpshooter - March 8, 2025
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Translation fixes in the tutorial and Codex.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Lefty Mode toggle was not functioning correctly. It should now work as intended for left-handed players.
[/list]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Laser sight to weapons to improve aiming.
[*] Hit indicators now change color based on the number of hits remaining.
[*] New Weapon Rotation Adjustment setting, allowing players to customize the rotation of their weapons to better suit their preferences.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Lightning Weapon Rework: Removed the charge-and-release mechanic for the lightning weapon. It now fires instantly when the shoot button is pressed. Making the weapon feel more responsive and intuitive to use.
[/list]

notes.title: Liv Integration/Difficulty Changes/Improved UI/Sound
notes.content:
-Players will now start on training mode difficulty as their default difficulty. Although if you're a shooter Veteran you can switch to Warrior mode right away. 
- Trials now indicate their difficulty level so players can have more of an idea of what they are getting into when picking a level.
- Players will have a codex to learn the game instead of being forced to do a tutorial. Although the tutorial is available to play at any time. 
- Players take less damage on Warrior mode difficulty.
- Enemies have been decreased on Training mode difficulty.
- Advanced sound settings have been implemented into the game. 
- Liv integration has been completed, content creators who have LIV are good to go.

notes.title: Difficulty Changes/UI Improvements/BugFixes
notes.content:
[h3][/h3]Difficulty Changes:
-Reduced damage received by the player to improve overall balance.
-Removed some enemy spawns on Trainee (Easy) and Warrior (Normal) difficulty.
-Anaki attack cooldown has been increased, resulting in fewer shots fired and making the enemy more balanced.

[h3][/h3]UI Improvements:
-Added volume settings, allowing players to adjust Music, SFX, and Voice volumes to their preference.
-Reworked the leaderboard UI, providing a cleaner and easier-to-read interface for tracking player scores.
-Added difficulty indicators to levels, making it clear for players which levels are more challenging and which are beginner-friendly.

[h3][/h3]Bug Fixes:
-Resolved minor bugs related to the leaderboard and UI, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable player experience.      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope these changes enhance your gaming experience. Enjoy playing Elysium Trials!
